rules: One poll owner at a time.
A wake during polling survives for the next poll.
Frozen or completed work cannot restart.

confidence: Strong local gate; scheduler partly covered
missing: Queue/frame integration, fairness, preemption and delivery latency.
summary: Permission to resume is exclusive; wakeups are retained.

rules: An inherited deadline can only tighten.
Deadline arithmetic cannot wrap into extra time.

confidence: Strong arithmetic; timer wheel partly covered
missing: Arbitrary calendar cascades, process ticker and real-time scheduling.

rules: Successful arena extents fit and do not overlap earlier extents.
Failure consumes no arena quota or cursor space.
Realloc preserves or releases the exact allocation owner.
basis: Full-width layout arithmetic; bounded real API lifecycles; allocator contracts
missing: Arbitrary allocation histories, OS allocator behavior and OOM abort execution.

rules: Each waker owner retains one reference.

basis: Bounded reference sequences and concurrent production ledger operations
missing: Complete descriptor walks, COW mutation, provider transfers and all generated clone/drop paths.
summary: References and quota balance across aliasing and abandoned work.

rules: Await cleanup has one terminal authority.
Semaphores conserve permits and hand them to live waiters.
Read-slot teardown preserves in-flight ownership.
Closed supervisors admit no pins; final pin release authorizes drain notification.
basis: Full-width gate arithmetic and bounded production compositions
confidence: Bounded lifecycle evidence; some unbounded scalar rules
missing: Every shutdown/destructor path, OS wait loops, arbitrary populations and unbounded progress.

rules: A pending root resumes at most once per consumed readiness notification.
Completed frames are destroyed once and their owner slot becomes null.
Results are observed after frame retirement; later polls touch no retired frame.
Missing/prematurely completed pending frames, yielded roots and unfinished terminal frames are rejected.

summary: Readiness permits resume; completion destroys and clears the frame owner.
